bitsat_branch_match_module.location: /app/frontend/src/components/results/LearningMeters.js (or new component embedded in Results 5-tab workspace under 'Real-exam rank')
bitsat_branch_match_module.behavior: Converts BITSAT score input into top 3 distinct program/campus matches using official historical BITSAT cutoffs (Pilani, Goa, Hyderabad). Shows maximum score benchmark 390.

ui_specs.score_input: Numeric input 0-390 with clear validation and default score populate from attempt
ui_specs.match_cards: Top 3 highest historical cutoff branches below candidate score, with clear campus badge (Pilani / Goa / Hyderabad), branch code, cutoff score, and margin
ui_specs.disclaimer: Includes official cutoff source citation (2025-2027 official session cutoffs) and explicit 'No admission guarantee' disclaimer as required by regulations
ui_specs.distinct_branches_rule: Ensures 3 distinct degree programs across campuses rather than duplicate branches

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Update JEE Main exam choice cards in ExamNavigation.js / CSS to use authentic Blood Red styling (#7F1D1D to #B91C1C gradient) with dark red accents and high contrast white text.
2. Update BITSAT exam choice cards to actual Tricolour Saffron Orange (#FF9933 / #EA580C) with readable dark ink typography (#1E1B18) to avoid muted brown tones.
3. Apply periodic CSS shine sweep animations on both mobile and desktop viewports, pausing on hover and respecting prefers-reduced-motion.

4. In Results view ('rank' tab for BITSAT exam attempts), render the Top 3 Branch Matches Panel allowing student score input, showing top 3 distinct B.E. programs with campus badges, cutoffs out of 390, and legal disclaimer.
5. Ensure all interactive and key data elements carry kebab-case data-testid attributes.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Maintain high contrast APCA / WCAG AA standards across both dark red and saffron backgrounds.
Never rely solely on hover transforms for mobile feedback; use keyframe animations with touch-friendly controls.
Ensure direct parent-child grid containment and no universal transitions break animation transforms.
Include explicit testids on all new form inputs, branch cards, score meters, and exam cards.
